site.title: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.heading: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.description: Rose Hallgren is an architect and designer in Stockholm, working with wool, wood, weaving and ceramics.
site.intro:
My practice lies between drawing and making: a house in the archipelago, a marbled outdoor stage, a tufted wall, a glazed vessel.

Passionate about wood and wool. Wool most of all: an old fibre that mostly gets thrown away today, and could be a building material instead. That was the subject of a workshop and exhibition at the Copenhagen Architecture Biennial, with Axfoundation, Dalarna Science Park and the Nordic Wool Initiative. The wood runs from prefabricated houses drawn for the factory to the Torö addition, awarded Ung Svensk Arkitektur 2023.

Educated at KTH. Previously at Anders Berensson Architects and AT-HH. Fanfaluca Collective is Jenny Hedén Malm and me — a film and an installation for Malmö in the Making, water, light and sound at Tjärö for Kulturföreningen PLX. C.O.U.A. is Matilda Franzén, Andreas Pettersson, Carolina Weigl and me, working on ornament at Alma Löv Museum. Lighting with Svartljus. The studio is at Åsögatan 122 in Stockholm, shared with SMASH and Jonas Johansson.
